# Paper Craft

**Scope (editorial).** This topic covers shaping paper into objects that hold their form. It is a test fixture, and every word of it is invented for automated tests.

The hull chapter tells the reader to stop after three folds, because "A fourth fold adds weight and no strength." [cite:fixture-mirrored-book/folding-the-hull@v1.0.0]

The recovery chapter says to lift a sunk boat by its keel fold and to dry it flat under a book. [cite:fixture-mirrored-book/recovering-a-sunk-boat@v1.0.0]
